headline: Muted show, turnaround to materialise from Q4FY27

highlights: EBITDA for Q2FY27 stood at ₹ 32 crore with margins at 4.5%, down 150 bps QoQ.
EBITDA/tonne moderated sharply with Lead segment reported EBITDA/tonne of ₹ 16k vs. ₹ 22k reported in Q1FY27 and ₹ 20k reported in Q2FY26.

Investment Rationale: • Sourcing issue to keep lead volumes muted in FY27E, eyeing recovery in FY28E : POCL has aggressively expanded its Lead smelting capacity with recently commissioned 72 KTPA facility, taking the total to 204 KTPA.
H1FY27 volumes however have been muted at ~31KT vs. 50KT clocked in H1FY26.
valuation: x ICICI Securities – Retail Equity Research Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Ltd (PONOXI) CMP: ₹380 Target ₹ 520 (37%) Target Period: 12 months November 16, 2026 Muted show, turnaround to materialise from Q4FY27 About the stock : Pondy Oxide and Chemicals (POCL), est. in 1995, is engaged in recycling & production of non-ferrous metals (Copper, Lead, Aluminium, and others).
Moreover, the phase 1 (18 KTPA) of cathode plant is targeted to be commissioned by Dec’26.

Rating and Target Price : We have a positive view on Pondy Oxide, supported by capacity expansion across lead and copper segments, increasing value-added products, net debt free B/S and healthy return ratios profile.
